task_text: Pick up the glass beaker and set it down on the white square plate. Success the moment, after the beaker's centre has been more than 10 cm above where it stood, the beaker has stood on the plate for one second (60 control steps in a row): its centre within 5 cm (horizontally) of the plate's centre and within 5 cm of the height at which it started, with the gripper more than 5 cm away from the beaker's centre (measured from the point between the fingertips).

inventory: glass beaker, about 11 cm across and 9 cm tall
white square target plate, 10 cm x 10 cm, flat
